Before we can get started, we need you to grant us permission to gather some basic phone usage statistics. Swipe through the images below to see how to do it, then hit the \"Open Settings Menu\" button.

This permission enables us to collect basic anonymous data about the way you use your phone. In our case, we use this permission to monitor what app you are using at a given time (for example, \"Email\" or \"Maps\").
Press \'Begin Screen Capture\' to get started. We will request a few more permissions afterward.

Open Usage needs your permission to access usage data to track what other apps you are using and how often to understand how people use smartphones in daily life.

The permission is required for Open Usage study participation with your explicit consent and must be activated manually. By tapping the "Allow" button below, you agree that this app collects your usage data. The data is collected only when the app is in use. If you do not agree, please tap "Deny" and discontinue use of the app.

The app does not collect any personal information to identify your data file, and the data will be encrypted and stored on a secure server that will not be accessible to anyone outside of our research project
.

We request Media Projection Permission to collect the information that is visible on your screen or played from your device while recording or casting to understand how people use smartphone in daily life. This includes information such as passwords, payment details, photos, messages, and audio that you play.

The permission is required for Open Usage study participation with your explicit consent and must be activated manually. By tapping the “Allow” button below, you agree that this app collects your precise location data. The data is collected only when the smartphone is in use. If you do not agree, please tap “Deny” and discontinue use of the app.

The app does not collect any personal information to identify your data file, and the data will be encrypted and stored on a secure server that will not be accessible to anyone outside of our research project.
We request Physical Activity Access Permission to collect your step count data to understand how people use smartphones in daily life.\n\nAllow Open Usage to access your physical activity?

We request Accessibility Permission to collect your interaction gesture data with your smartphone (i.e., tap, swipe, and scroll events) to understand how people use smartphones in daily life.

The permission is required for Open Usage study participation with your explicit consent and must be activated manually. By tapping the “Allow” button below, you agree that this app collects your interaction gesture data. The data is collected only when the app is in use. If you do not agree, please tap “Deny” and discontinue use of the app.

Open Usage needs your permission to send push notifications to keep you up to date with the study requirements and procedures you follow.\n\nAllow Open Usage to send you notifications?
The permission is required for Open Usage study participation.
Open Usage needs your permission to read notifications to keep you up to date with the study requirements and procedures you follow.\n\nAllow Open Usage to read notifications?

We request Location Access Permission to collect your real-time location data of your device to understand how people use smartphone in daily life.

The permission is required for Open Usage study participation with your explicit consent and must be activated manually. By tapping the "Allow" button below, you agree that this app collects your precise location data. The data is continuously collected when the app is not in use. If you do not agree, please tap "Deny" and discontinue use of the app.
